commands_run.command:
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import ast, asyncio, concurrent.futures
from pathlib import Path
source = ast.parse(Path('triggarr/web/routes.py').read_text())
names = {'_await_claimed_write', '_close_removed_client'}
module = ast.Module(body=[ast.ImportFrom(module='__future__', names=[ast.alias(name='annotations')], level=0)] + [n for n in source.body if isinstance(n, ast.AsyncFunctionDef) and n.name in names], type_ignores=[])
ns = {'asyncio': asyncio, 'concurrent': concurrent}
exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(module), '<review helpers>', 'exec'), ns)
async def main():
    for fail in (False, True):
        outcome = concurrent.futures.Future()
        outcome.set_running_or_notify_cancel()
        task = asyncio.create_task(ns['_await_claimed_write'](outcome))
        await asyncio.sleep(0)
        task.cancel()
        await asyncio.sleep(0)
        task.cancel()
        await asyncio.sleep(0)
        if fail:
            outcome.set_exception(OSError('disk full'))
        else:
            outcome.set_result(None)
        error, cancelled = await task
        assert isinstance(cancelled, asyncio.CancelledError)
        assert isinstance(error, OSError) if fail else error is None
    class Client:
        done = False
        async def close(self):
            await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
            self.done = True
    client = Client()
    task = asyncio.create_task(ns['_close_removed_client'](client))
    await asyncio.sleep(0)
    task.cancel()
    await asyncio.sleep(0)
    task.cancel()
    error, cancelled = await task
    assert client.done and error is None and isinstance(cancelled, asyncio.CancelledError)
    print('PASS: repeated cancellation preserves write outcomes and completes client close')
asyncio.run(main())
PY
